kemal_tr: Bugün sahada sadece futbol oynamayacağız, karakterimizi koyacağız.
İlk düdükten son düdüğe kadar bu formanın hakkını vereceksiniz.
Taktik çalışır ama yürekle oynanan maç kazanılır.
Rakip kim olursa olsun, burası bizim kalemiz.
Gözlerime bakın, bugün bu maçı alacağımıza inanıyorum.
Son dakikaya kadar mücadele etmeyen bu formayı giyemez.
Top bizdeyken sakin, rakipteyken acımasız olacağız.
Her ikili mücadeleyi kazanmak için var gücünüzle yüklenin.
Sahada bir takım gibi hareket edin, bireysel oynamayın.
Kendinize güvenin, benden çok ben size güveniyorum.
Disiplin başarının tek anahtarıdır, kurala uyun.
Sahaya çıkın ve ne kadar iyi olduğunuzu herkese gösterin.
kemal_en: Today on the pitch, we won't just play football, we will show our character.
From the first whistle to the last, you will honor this jersey.
Tactics matter, but matches are won with heart.
No matter who the opponent is, this is our fortress.
Do not be afraid of making mistakes, be afraid of cowardice.
Look into my eyes, I believe we will win this match today.
Anyone who doesn't fight until the last minute cannot wear this shirt.
We will be calm when we have the ball, and ruthless when we don't.
Championships are won on the pitch, not on paper.
Today is the day we pay our debt to the fans.
Fight until the very last drop of your sweat.
Be a wall in defense, a storm in attack.
We will attack together, we will defend together.
We will play with our brains, not just our feet.
Giving up is not in our dictionary.
Push with all your might to win every single duel.
Act as a team on the field, do not play individually.
Today is our turn to make history.
We will break the opponent's resistance in the first 15 minutes.
Trust yourselves, I trust you more than you know.
We will dedicate this match to our fans.
Discipline is the only key to success, follow the rules.
The badge on the shirt is above everything else.
Step on the pitch and show everyone how good you are.
Victory will be ours, believe in it!
